notes: TBox subject insert as a class inclusion.

fol.notes: The edit's 'is the square of a positive whole number' uses a Skolem function root(n) (local), and is instantiated at the numbers the queries ask about (50 and m); the general rule is nonlinear.

local.root: Skolem function of the edit: the positive whole number whose square a velmic number is

edit: All(n, [50, m], Implies(velmic(n), And(root(n) > 0, n == root(n) * root(n))))

m_velmic.says: The number m is a velmic number between 50 and 70.
